description:
## Goal

Maintain rooted product support so many affected branches sharing an unchanged alternate prefix pay for that prefix once, not once per branch.

Work on the final ProductMemo membership/witness model after exact product-request and fact-edge cutovers. Rooted support is derived routing evidence over the one committed membership graph, never a second ancestry graph, clearance cache, global scan or retained value authority.

Prove long nonleaf removed branches, one/two/alternating alternate branches, stale detach/reseed, back-edge rejection, exact wait admission and unchanged/unrelated zero work. Count all path construction, lookup, hashing, cloning, allocation and maintenance. Delete repeated prefix walks and probes; preserve values, generations and artifacts.
title: Maintain rooted support without repeated prefix walks
